description: Sampled acoustic drum kit: ten voices drawn from 27 recorded instruments or your own samples, each with several velocity layers, several takes per layer, and a close and a room microphone

params.text: Sets how hard that voice is struck; the knob is multiplied by the voltage at the Velocity input of the same voice
Places that voice in the stereo picture, from hard left at one end to hard right at the other
Fades that voice between its close microphone recording at one end and its room microphone recording at the other, which is how much room ambience it carries
Tunes that voice, marked in octaves

inputs.text: Plays a note on that voice each time a trigger arrives
Boosts the volume of the note being triggered on that voice, which also lifts it into the next velocity layer up
Sets how hard that voice is struck; the voltage here is multiplied by the Velocity knob of the same voice
Moves that voice across the stereo picture
Fades that voice between its close microphone recording and its room microphone recording
Shifts the pitch of that voice

outputs.text: The left channel of the ten voices mixed together, or the mono mix when the Right Mix output is unpatched
The right channel of the ten voices mixed together
That voice on its own, carrying the left channel of its stereo pair, or the whole voice in mono when its Right output is unpatched
The right channel of that voice on its own

notes: clicking a voice name opens the list of built-in instruments, the custom sample options, and Instrument options, which holds a gain slider and early decay sliders
Instrument options also chooses, for velocity, pan, distance and tuning, whether a change applies while a note sounds or is frozen at the hit; pan and distance are real time by default
the stepped bar beside each Velocity knob shows the velocity layers that voice was recorded at, and clicking a layer switches it off so that even hard hits use a quieter recording
the Factory presets display offers Close & dry, Balanced, Big room, Laid back and Full on, each of which sets the velocity layers and microphone distance of all ten voices
the hi-hat instruments behave as one physical hi-hat, so a pedal hi-hat chokes a ringing open one; the instrument list also carries independent variants that do not choke
a custom sample is loaded from a WAV or AIFF file; files beside it whose names carry v1, v2 and so on become velocity layers, and r1, r2 and so on become takes within a layer
the module has no sequencer of its own and makes no sound until a trigger arrives at a voice's Trigger input; the ten voices come with a drum kit already assigned
menu: Include connected instruments in mixed outputs — keeps a voice in the mixed outputs even when its own outputs are patched; switched off, a patched voice is left out of the mix
